theory.aim: To study the effect of reflux ratio on the performance of a distillation column.
theory.description: Distillation is a separation process based on differences in volatility of components in a mixture. The reflux ratio plays a significant role in determining the purity of the distillate and the number of stages required. This experiment demonstrates how increasing reflux improves separation efficiency at the cost of increased energy consumption.
procedure: Feed the mixture into the distillation column.
Allow the column to reach steady state.
Determine the number of theoretical and actual stages.

diagnostics.message: Low distillate purity. Increase reflux ratio.

viva: Why does increasing reflux improve separation?
